name: io.github.nirholas/threews-agent-trader
title: three.ws Agent Trader
description: Can move real SOL. Arm agents on Oracle calls (simulate default), watch them, kill switch.

environmentVariables.name: THREE_WS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: REQUIRED. WARNING: this server can move real SOL. The agent owner's three.ws API key (sk_live_... / sk_test_...) or OAuth access token, sent as Authorization: Bearer. Treat it like a password. THREE_WS_TOKEN / THREE_WS_BEARER are accepted aliases.

environmentVariables.name: THREE_WS_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the three.ws API that serves the autopilot endpoints. Override only when self-hosting or targeting a preview deployment.
